```sql
SELECT c.id,
       c.email,
       c.company,
       c.country_code,
       sum(o.total_cents) AS revenue,
       count(*)           AS order_count,
       max(o.created_at)  AS last_order_at
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o
    ON o.customer_id = c.id
   AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
 WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
 GROUP BY c.id
HAVING max(o.created_at) >= %(from)s
   AND max(o.created_at) <  %(to)s
 ORDER BY sum(o.total_cents) DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De gematerialiseerde CTE, de `DISTINCT ON` en de herhaalde `HashAggregate` in de nested loop (48 miljoen rijen weggefilterd) zijn vervangen door één join en één aggregatie. De laatste orderdatum is nu `max(created_at)`, gefilterd in `HAVING`, en de tenantfilter op `customers` beperkt de te aggregeren orders. Kolommen, rijen en sortering blijven gelijk aan het origineel.
